seg.sub.zh: 把一部完整影片切成分集：选源片、去水印，由 Studio 找出每一集的结束点，你来检查，渲染分集并质检，最后把影片导入为剧集。
seg.sub.en: Cut a finished film into episodes: pick the source film, remove its logo, let Studio find where each episode should end, check those ends, render the episodes, check them, then import the film as a title.

seg.list.empty.zh: 还没有切分任务。点“新建任务”，选一部影片把它切成分集。
seg.list.empty.en: No runs yet. Press New run and pick a film to cut it into episodes.

seg.mode.by_eye_2min.hint.zh: 连续分集，目标 120 秒（95–150 秒区间），边界由视觉判断决定。
seg.mode.by_eye_2min.hint.en: Continuous episodes, target 120 s in a 95–150 s band; the vision pass decides each boundary.

seg.mode.source_episodes.hint.zh: 按源片自带的“未完待续”卡切分并去掉卡片。
seg.mode.source_episodes.hint.en: Cut at the source's own "to be continued" cards and trim the cards out.

seg.mode.narrated.hint.zh: 高质量剧集的叙述路线是下一阶段。
seg.mode.narrated.hint.en: The narrated route for high-quality drama is the next phase.

seg.stageHint.intake.zh: 链接源片、同步脚本、记录版本
seg.stageHint.intake.en: Link the source, sync the scripts, record the version

seg.stageHint.watermark.en: Detect the logo; you confirm the box

seg.stageHint.index.zh: 转写、镜头切换、动作和可切点
seg.stageHint.index.en: Transcript, shot changes, motion and safe cut points

seg.stageHint.cards.en: Find the source's "to be continued" cards

seg.stageHint.plan.zh: 分区并渲染每个边界的候选帧
seg.stageHint.plan.en: Partition and render the option strips

seg.stageHint.vision.zh: 审阅者与质疑者逐边界判断
seg.stageHint.vision.en: A reviewer and a skeptic judge every boundary

seg.stageHint.review.zh: 你审阅低置信度与被质疑的边界
seg.stageHint.review.en: You review the low-confidence and disputed boundaries

seg.stageHint.render.en: Cut the episodes and verify the built files

seg.stageHint.qa.zh: 每集的首尾帧与去标区域
seg.stageHint.qa.en: Each episode's first and last frames and the logo-removal areas

seg.stageHint.handoff.en: Hand off to the import; the film becomes a title

seg.intake.sub.zh: 在这台电脑上选源片（不经浏览器上传），给影片目录命名，选择切法和对白语言。
seg.intake.sub.en: Pick the source film on this computer (it is not uploaded through the browser), name its folder, and choose how to cut it and the language spoken.

seg.intake.pathPlaceholder.zh: 这台机器上的绝对路径
seg.intake.pathPlaceholder.en: An absolute folder path on this machine

seg.intake.listing.zh: 正在读取文件并探测画面…

seg.intake.refuse.placeholder.zh: 云端占位文件：内容不在本机，先在 OneDrive 里设为“始终保留在此设备上”。
seg.intake.refuse.placeholder.en: A cloud placeholder: its bytes are not on this machine. Make it "always keep on this device" in OneDrive first.

seg.intake.refuse.landscape.zh: 横屏源片（{w}×{h}）：纯切分路线没有重构图步骤，请先问 Ruobin。
seg.intake.refuse.landscape.en: A landscape source ({w}×{h}): the cut-only route has no reframe step. Ask Ruobin first.

seg.intake.warn.noProbe.en: The video could not be probed.

seg.intake.slugHint.zh: 影片目录名，只用小写字母、数字和连字符；影片保存为 projects/{bucket}/<目录名>/source/original.mp4。测试目录可以用一个下划线开头。
seg.intake.slugHint.en: The film's folder name, in lower-case letters, digits and dashes; the film is saved as projects/{bucket}/<name>/source/original.mp4. A test folder may start with one underscore.

seg.intake.slugBad.zh: 只能用小写字母、数字和连字符（临时目录可以一个下划线开头）。
seg.intake.slugBad.en: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes only (a scratch folder may start with one underscore).

seg.intake.langHint.zh: 影片里说的语言（例如 en 或 zh），转写按这个语言进行。
seg.intake.langHint.en: The language spoken in the film (for example en or zh); the transcript is made in it.

seg.intake.firstProof.en: First proof: the first 15 minutes only

seg.intake.firstProofHint.zh: 只切前 15 分钟，先看几集，再决定是否为整部影片花钱。
seg.intake.firstProofHint.en: Cuts only the first 15 minutes, so you can watch a few episodes before spending on the whole film.

seg.intake.noDelogoHint.en: Skips finding and removing a logo.

seg.intake.allowDirty.zh: 即使流水线脚本有未保存的改动也运行
seg.intake.allowDirty.en: Run even if the pipeline's scripts have unsaved changes

seg.intake.allowDirtyHint.zh: 默认拒绝：有人改了流水线脚本但没有保存（提交）。
seg.intake.allowDirtyHint.en: Refused by default: someone changed a pipeline script and did not save (commit) it.

seg.intake.visionHandoff.zh: 视觉判断交给 Claude Code
seg.intake.visionHandoff.en: Hand the vision pass to Claude Code

seg.intake.visionHandoffHint.zh: Studio 不自己调用 AI：它显示要在 Claude Code 里运行的命令，并等待结果文件。
seg.intake.visionHandoffHint.en: Studio does not call the AI itself: it shows the command to run in Claude Code and waits for its answer file.

seg.intake.claimExisting.zh: 接管一个不是 Studio 建的影片目录
seg.intake.claimExisting.en: Take over an existing folder Studio did not make

seg.intake.claimExistingHint.zh: 默认拒绝：这个目录里已经有不是 Studio 发起的切片工作（有人手工处理过）。勾选即接管它，脚本会更新到最新。
seg.intake.claimExistingHint.en: Refused by default: this folder already holds cut work Studio did not start (someone worked on it by hand). Tick this to take it over; its scripts are brought up to date.

seg.intake.extend.zh: 续切一部已交付的影片

seg.intake.extendHint.zh: 已交付、就绪或已导入的影片默认拒绝再切。勾选后保留已交付的分集（钉住），只切剩下的部分；关闭“先只做前 15 分钟”。
seg.intake.extendHint.en: A delivered, ready or imported film is refused by default. Ticked, its delivered episodes stay pinned and only the rest is cut; the first proof is switched off.

seg.intake.startFailed.en: The run could not be created.

seg.intake.startFailedDetail.en: The run could not be created: {detail}

seg.run.cancelConfirm.zh: 取消这个任务？正在运行的脚本会被终止；已写入的文件保留。
seg.run.cancelConfirm.en: Cancel this run? A running script is killed; files already written stay.

seg.run.queued.en: Waiting for a worker to claim the run…

seg.run.failedHint.zh: 上面是流水线原话。修好它指出的问题后新建任务；Studio 不会自行强制重跑。
seg.run.failedHint.en: The pipeline's own words are above. Fix what it names and start a new run; Studio never forces a rerun on its own.

seg.wm.detecting.zh: 正在从画面里测量台标…
seg.wm.detecting.en: Measuring the logo from the footage…

seg.wm.look.zh: 先看图再信框：证据条来自四个不同场景并画出了框；中位图里的框应该把整个台标连同软边一起包住，边缘外要干净。
seg.wm.look.en: Look before trusting the box: the evidence strip shows four scenes with the box drawn; in the median image the box should hold the whole logo, soft edge included, with clean pixels outside it.

seg.wm.foundAlt.en: The logo box drawn on four scenes

seg.wm.medianAlt.zh: 全片中位图，台标留下，场景消失
seg.wm.medianAlt.en: The median over the film: the logo stays, scenes vanish

seg.wm.regionLabel.zh: 重新检测的搜索区域（源片像素）
seg.wm.regionLabel.en: Search region for a new detection (source pixels)

seg.wm.regionBad.en: The region runs off the frame.

seg.vision.running.zh: 审阅者与质疑者正在逐边界判断…
seg.vision.running.en: The reviewer and skeptic are judging each boundary…

seg.vision.unavailable.zh: 视觉模型不可用：{reason}。可以交给 Claude Code。
seg.vision.unavailable.en: Vision provider unavailable: {reason}. Hand it to Claude Code instead.

seg.vision.command.zh: 在 Claude Code 里运行的 Workflow 命令
seg.vision.command.en: The Workflow call to run in Claude Code

seg.review.sub.zh: 置信度低于 0.65、被质疑者推翻、或质疑者的改动未经核实的边界必须由你决定；其余已预先接受，折叠在下面。
seg.review.sub.en: Every boundary under confidence 0.65, overridden by the skeptic, or with a skeptic's fix the guard could not verify needs your decision; the rest are pre-accepted and collapsed below.

seg.review.doorHint.zh: 渲染前先审阅边界：接受、移动、退回重判或删除。
seg.review.doorHint.en: Review the boundaries before the render: accept, move, send back or remove each.

seg.review.notYet.en: The option strips are not ready yet.

seg.review.readOnly.zh: 任务现在处于“{stage}”阶段，只能查看。
seg.review.readOnly.en: The run is at "{stage}"; the cards are read-only.

seg.review.counts.total.zh: 共 {n} 个边界，到 {span}，区间 {lo}–{hi} 秒

seg.review.group.conflictHint.zh: 两个都对的选择让中间那集超出了 {lo}–{hi} 秒。移动其中一个，或删除一个边界。
seg.review.group.conflictHint.en: Two right choices left the episode between them outside {lo}–{hi} s. Move one of them, or remove a boundary.

seg.review.group.rest.zh: 审阅者与质疑者一致的 {n} 个边界（已预先接受）
seg.review.group.rest.en: {n} boundaries agreed by reviewer and skeptic (pre-accepted)

seg.review.skepticApplied.zh: 质疑者的 {t} 将被应用

seg.review.stripAlt.zh: 候选 {key}，切点 {t}，每 0.5 秒一帧

seg.review.chosenStrip.zh: 所选候选 {key} · {t}（高亮格为切点）
seg.review.chosenStrip.en: Chosen option {key} · {t} (the marked tile is the cut)

seg.review.nearestStrip.zh: 候选 {key} · {t}（当前切点不是列出的候选）
seg.review.nearestStrip.en: Option {key} · {t} (the current cut is not a listed option)

seg.review.noProxy.zh: 这个切点的预览片段还没渲染。
seg.review.noProxy.en: No proxy clip rendered for this cut yet.

seg.review.proxyLabel.zh: 切点 {t} 前后各 5 秒

seg.review.moveTitle.zh: 移到另一个候选，或 ±30 秒内任一合法切点
seg.review.moveTitle.en: Move to another option, or any legal cut within ±30 s

seg.review.notLegal.zh: 不是列出的候选或合法切点
seg.review.notLegal.en: not a listed option or legal cut

seg.review.rejectTitle.en: Why the skeptic should look again

seg.review.rejectPlaceholder.zh: 例如：切在了拳头落下之前
seg.review.rejectPlaceholder.en: For example: the cut lands before the punch connects

seg.review.ready.zh: 所有需要决定的边界都已决定，可以应用。
seg.review.ready.en: Every boundary that needed you is decided; ready to apply.

seg.review.notReady.zh: 还有 {undecided} 个边界待决定，{conflicts} 组区间冲突。

seg.joins.sub.zh: 成片已渲染：每个衔接播放前一集最后 2 秒与后一集最前 2 秒。
seg.joins.sub.en: The episodes are built: each join plays the last 2 s of one and the first 2 s of the next.

seg.joins.hint.zh: 移动一个衔接只重渲染它两侧的两集。
seg.joins.hint.en: Moving a join re-renders only the two episodes it touches.

seg.joins.title.zh: 第 {k} 集 → 第 {next} 集 · {t}

seg.joins.playerLabel.zh: 第 {k} 集与下一集的衔接

seg.joins.moveTitle.zh: 选一个附近的合法切点

seg.joins.notYet.en: Available once the render has finished.

seg.qa.hint.zh: 每集一张：首尾帧、去标区域的原尺寸裁切、黑场与静止段。红字是脚本量出的问题。
seg.qa.hint.en: One per episode: the first and last frames, full-size crops of every logo-removal area, black and still stretches. Red lines are what the script measured.

seg.meta.hintQa.zh: 看过上面的质检表后填写；保存即结束质检。
seg.meta.hintQa.en: Fill it in once the sheets above are looked at; saving ends the QA wait.

seg.meta.spoilerHint.zh: 默认全片一半；之后的画面不进广告。
seg.meta.spoilerHint.en: Defaults to half the runtime; nothing after it goes into an ad.

seg.meta.exclusions.en: Windows an ad may never use

seg.meta.posterHint.zh: poster/final/ 下的文件名（不含扩展名），可留空。
seg.meta.posterHint.en: The file stem under poster/final/; leave empty when none.

seg.handoff.hint.zh: 影片显示可导入后（渲染结束几分钟后），就可以导入：它会成为一部剧集，分集就是这里切好的文件。
seg.handoff.hint.en: When the film reads ready (a few quiet minutes after the render), it can be imported: it becomes a title whose episodes are the files cut here.

seg.intake.rootMissing.zh: 这台机器上没有这个目录。
seg.intake.rootMissing.en: This folder does not exist on this machine.

seg.review.reason.skeptic_unverified.zh: 质疑者的改动未经核实

seg.review.guardRule.unseen_time.zh: 质疑者没有看过这个时间点的画面
seg.review.guardRule.unseen_time.en: A time the skeptic never saw

seg.review.guardRule.band.zh: 会让一集的时长超出区间
seg.review.guardRule.band.en: An episode would leave the band

seg.review.guardRule.bury.zh: 会把过场卡埋进这一集里（规则 7）
seg.review.guardRule.bury.en: Would bury the card inside the episode (rule 7)

seg.review.guardRule.check.zh: 审看者的回答两次没有通过检查
seg.review.guardRule.check.en: The reviewer's answer failed its check twice

seg.review.rejudgingHint.zh: 已请求 {asked} 次重判，完成 {done} 次；等质疑者再看一遍。
seg.review.rejudgingHint.en: {asked} re-judge(s) asked, {done} done; waiting for the skeptic to look again.

seg.review.proxyFailed.zh: 预览片段无法播放（正在从源片生成，稍后刷新）。
seg.review.proxyFailed.en: The proxy clip did not play (it is made from the source on first request; refresh in a moment).

seg.review.acceptRefused.zh: 没有可接受的判断（无记录或置信度 0）：请移动到一个合法切点。
seg.review.acceptRefused.en: Nothing to accept (no record, or confidence 0): move it to a legal cut instead.

seg.review.doorCounts.zh: 需要决定 {need} · 已决定 {decided} · 预先接受 {pre} · 重判中 {rejudging}
seg.review.doorCounts.en: {need} need a decision · {decided} decided · {pre} pre-accepted · {rejudging} re-judging

seg.joins.noCuts.zh: 这个衔接附近没有列出的合法切点。
seg.joins.noCuts.en: No legal cuts listed near this join.

seg.wm.unmarkFit.zh: 已有透明水印的拟合（index/unmark/）；渲染时会一并减去。
seg.wm.unmarkFit.en: A see-through mark fit exists (index/unmark/); the render subtracts it too.

seg.wm.noVideoSize.zh: 还不知道画面尺寸，无法换算区域。
seg.wm.noVideoSize.en: The frame size is not known yet, so a region cannot be converted.

seg.cards.hint.zh: 沿用源片分集：输入几张卡出现的时间（秒），Studio 以它们为样本找出全部卡片。
seg.cards.hint.en: Source-episodes mode: type the film times (seconds) of a few cards; Studio uses them as samples to find every card.

seg.cards.save.zh: 用这 {n} 个时间找卡片
seg.cards.save.en: Find the cards from these {n} times

seg.run.heavyLock.zh: 等待机器空闲：{holder} 正在 {what}。
seg.run.heavyLock.en: Waiting for the machine: {holder} is running {what}.

seg.vision.handoffHint.zh: 在 Claude Code 里运行下面的 Workflow，把它的 .output 文件路径贴回来。
seg.vision.handoffHint.en: Run the Workflow below in Claude Code and paste the path of its .output file back here.

seg.vision.outputHint.zh: 这台机器上的完整路径；Studio 会读取并应用它。
seg.vision.outputHint.en: The full path on this machine; Studio reads the result from there and applies it.

seg.handoff.waitingReady.zh: 等待影片显示可导入（渲染结束后安静五分钟）
seg.handoff.waitingReady.en: Waiting for the film to read ready (five quiet minutes after the render)
